steps.content: Ever since the day you first met him, that's just the kind of guy he was.
<color=#fb9259><i>Hehehe... Haha... Coming back to life... Soon...<color=#dg1f1f><i>
<color=#fb9259><i>Give it back to me... Give it all back to me...<color=#dg1f1f><i>
Unable to confront the monster, he just planned to use his mechanisms to delay the inevitable, allowing everyone a chance to flee.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Syndicate is ours! Rustfire will take back everything that was lost!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Our fires will rage and burn you all to ashes!
Lacking the might to halt a gang of madmen, he hopes to exchange himself for control over their zeal, cutting off the roots of this Mania.

steps.speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
steps.content: Hehe... Our fires... will rage... Hahaha...

steps.speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
steps.content: Syndicate belongs to us...

Without the strength to annihilate those Corruptors desperate to escape the Black Ring's confines and spread beyond, he creates a maze to ensnare them. He pursues and corks their seething rage, keeping the Corruptors firmly under his control.
[Corpus 002-CG]

Powerless to stop the Black Ring's relentless growth, he channels the burgeoning energy into the High Tower, stretching higher and higher, further from the ground, further from the realm of the living.

He reconstructs his most prized stronghold, cutting off both Paradeisos and the Underground from the outside world. He is determined that those who abuse the West District will never reap what they sow.
[Transition] Cutscene: In a wheelchair, gazing out over the terrace

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I am weak, always have been.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: No sturdy legs to stand on, no formidable power to wield, nor a constantly soaring spirit to fight with.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: So, it's a constant cycle of failure, a never-ending loss for me...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: But, even for someone like me, there are still roles I can fulfill...

Like you mentioned, his dream was simply to be an architect. An architect has no use for the Syndicate's violence. With his determination and skills, he managed to hold off the crisis for a whole eight months.
Both of you... cut from the same cloth... were the most stubborn, the strongest leaders of Rustfire.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Ah, I see it now...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Next, it's your turn.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: That's what he meant when he said that...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You all still think... I'm capable...
Listening to your words, his eyes drift away, movements slow. Gradually, he sinks into the abyss of decay, with numerous small hands emerging from the sludge, as if trying to pull him under.

options: Donald? Come on, snap out of it!

steps.content: Don't get swallowed by the illusion!

You slap him once more, realizing it's going to take a lot longer to bring him back this time. His ties with BR-002 run deep. The willpower that the Black Ring couldn't erode nine years ago now appears to be facing an even bigger challenge.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I dozed off again, didn't I?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's alright, it was a nice dream. Seemed like a lot of old pals dropped by.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I hate to say it, but part of me thought Julien might have thrown in the towel. He turned to the Black Ring, lost in his own despair, and I just couldn't pull him back when it counted.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: So, I appreciate it. Thanks for letting me know he hasn't changed, still battling to the bitter end.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's just a botched plan, no worries, I've become accustomed to setbacks.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: After a setback, just pick yourself up and move forward.
...Still making eloquent speeches, even now?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's just the way I am, a remnant of a past era.
He tugs at you once more, hoisting you a bit from the quagmire. Just having that brief respite to breathe is a relief.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: The escape plan is in full swing. Sure, the outside may be tough, but it's not all doom and gloom.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's being trapped in Syndicate that's been our agony. We look to the West District from the Inner Bay, and to Eastside from there. So why not step out of Dis and see the bigger picture? Sounds good to me.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Would that leave you feeling unsatisfied? Oh... you're not like me; you have your own aspirations.
Contamination gradually converges on you, turning into black hands that emit a mournful cry, climbing up Donald's body and pulling him like a million companions thirsting for him to stay.
Donald's footsteps grow heavier, his body sinks deeper, but he only looks at you. After a while of silence, he smiles.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Well, I'll lend you a hand.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: The shackles of the Sinner, DisCity's Shepherd, the Second Black Ring's envoy, the idol who ignited a craze in Rustfire, the one my closest friend sacrificed his life to save.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Paradeisos's right, if there's anyone who can change the course of things, it must be you.
Just before plunging back, Donald grabs your hand, and suddenly, a chilly object snaps onto your wrist. That's his hook-lock.
...What do you want to do?
You grab Donald's hand abruptly, a burst of red light erupting, impaling his wrist.
Stop this madness! Go after what you want, but don't rely on me! I don't need your sacrifices, no more risking your lives!
A burst of red light, and your voice directly pierces Donald's mind, turning absolute determination into an absolute command; this is the prohibition, and Sinners can't defy it.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Is this the prohibition? Just like Margaret's rolling pin, it makes you utterly powerless. Looks like Julien sacrificing lives for your sake really got on your nerves.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Don't worry, I'm not cut out for this. I can't even meet other people's expectations, so why would I do that to you?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Good talk, though. "Go after what you want..." You're here for something you want, too, right?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's not about Rustfire, nor is it about saving the world... It's about cherishing what matters most to you. You've come to discover the truth and put an end to it all, so you can return to their side, alive and well.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Well, then, off you go. I'll pave the way for you and do you a solid.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: After it's all said and done, once we're out of here, you'll have to repay me for sure.
Hold it! You must stay alive, you can't—

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: As you command, my lord.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: But from here on out, you'll have to be on your own for a while..

Just before the pollution could capture both of you again, Donald presses the switch on your wrist. With a snap, a grappling hook shoots out and latches onto something high above. You feel a powerful force yank you out of the muck and propel you upward. Just you alone.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Give me a moment to slack off and catch up with some old pals. Hearing you, I really do miss them...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I'll catch up with you... later...
With a grin, Donald unleashes a lightning arc, severing the pursuers of ${PlayerName}. Better to leave these old pals behind as company for him.
